SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: Good, because I don't have the explanation.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: He knew a face. Mine happened to be standing there.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: I've got enough problems I already understand, I don't much care about ones I don't.

SUN_S1E01_P02.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P02.text: Bah. Leave it alone. I didn't mean anything by that.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: He had this before you walked in.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I rescued it from being evidence nobody noticed.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: It says Varnok would come through today.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: Then whoever wrote it got the name wrong.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: The day is the part I don't like.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I wasn't agreeing with you. I was narrowing the problem.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: You had his bag before he agreed to go.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I trust what I've seen him do.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Jessa
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I don't know him well enough for a careless one.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: I can hear both of you.

SUN_S1E01_P07.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E01_P07.text: Do either of you know where we're going?

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: It isn't meant to be you exactly.

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: It's the day Marcus lost the porch.

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: Does it bother you that they made him into a better version of you?

SUN_S1E06_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E06_P04.text: He isn't a version of me. They made somebody else and used my face.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: They know your name and kept Varnok.

SUN_S1E06_P06.speaker: Tomas
SUN_S1E06_P06.text: Some of us don't need him anymore.

SUN_S1E11_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P04.text: If I tell you what I think, you'll start listening to Jessa for proof of it.

SUN_S1E11_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E11_P04.text: Then you have an answer to that question.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: We still have to ask whether he knows Darrow.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: No. I don't think we do.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: You don't know every year of his life.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: He can surprise us. He probably will. But he's Kael.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: Then Darrow is the interesting part.

SUN_S1E12_P04.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P04.text: I preferred being the boring part.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I wanted you to be him.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: Then I could be finished with this.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: Lysa died believing he'd come. I promised her.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: So what am I supposed to do with it?

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: The preacher would have something better.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Samuel
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I am trying very hard not to.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: I only know I'm not Darrow. Opening it for me won't make your promise complete.

SUN_S1E12_P05.speaker: Maela Crow
SUN_S1E12_P05.text: So I still have to decide.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: The page that says 'Who is Kael?'

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Veyra
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: What did you put in its place?

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: I know the question. I don't know how to write it.

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Eva
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: Why do people keep getting a version of him before he gets there?

SUN_S1E12_P06.speaker: Kael
SUN_S1E12_P06.text: I still don't particularly need the answer.
